theme.description: Premium, highly trustworthy, editorial, and sophisticated. Avoid generic SaaS or crypto templates. It must communicate Trust, Accuracy, Stability, Professionalism, Financial Intelligence, and Human Expertise.
theme.archetype: Old Money Tech / Swiss Brutalist hybrid - classic serif paired with sterile functional components.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-none text-midnight-ink
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight text-midnight-ink

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 'Newsreader' and 'Manrope' are imported from Google Fonts in index.html. DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings. DO NOT center-align headings unless it's a specific stylistic choice (e.g., FAQ header). Oversized typography should be left-aligned in editorial layouts.

surface_strategy.background_dark: bg-[#0B172A] (Midnight Ink) for Tally Skills or Footer to create high contrast
surface_strategy.borders: border-[#879B83]/30 (Muted Sage transparent) for thin rules and ledger grids

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Add these colors to tailwind.config.js under `theme.extend.colors`. Never use pure white (#FFFFFF); use ivory (#F5F1E8) for surfaces. Tally Skills section should utilize `midnight-ink` background with `ivory` text and `tally-accent` (muted amber) for interactive states.

principles: Generous whitespace (use p-12 to p-32 for sections).
Ledger-inspired structure: thin vertical and horizontal rules to separate content, not floating boxes.
Custom motifs: debit/credit markers, tabular numerals, ₹ typography, invoice numbering.
Avoid identical rounded card grids. Use sharp edges or max 4px rounding.

navbar.style: Sticky navigation, scroll-solidify to crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F5F1E8]/80 border-b border-[#879B83]/20). DO NOT use fully transparent background.
navbar.elements: Logo (serif), 4-5 text links (sans), Primary CTA (pill-shaped, Midnight Ink background).

hero.style: Editorial Hero. Left 60% massive serif headline. Right 40% abstract CSS accounting/ledger composition. No fake dashboard screenshots.
hero.elements: H1 text, subtle animated underline, primary CTA, secondary link, right side composed of fine CSS lines, geometric shapes, and tabular numbers fading in.

trust_strip.style: Horizontal marquee ticker using `react-fast-marquee`. Low contrast, Warm Paper background, Muted Sage typography.
trust_strip.elements: Accounting certifications, partners, or 'Trust • Accuracy • Compliance' separated by subtle dot or cross icons.

services_grid.style: Asymmetric editorial grid. Accounting & Bookkeeping spans multiple rows/cols. Thin border rules separating grid items (border-collapse look).
services_grid.elements: Grid cols 1 to 12. Use subgrid if possible. Numbered items (01, 02) in serif.

tally_skills_academy.style: Visually distinct. Dark theme inside (Midnight Ink background). High contrast.
tally_skills_academy.elements: Interactive vertical curriculum index (01-07). Hover reveals image or detail. Big typographic statement 'DON\'T JUST LEARN WHERE TO CLICK. UNDERSTAND WHAT THE ENTRY MEANS.' in ivory or tally-accent.

contact_form.style: Premium simple form using Shadcn Input/Textarea but heavily customized to look like a physical paper ledger.
contact_form.elements: Bottom border only for inputs (border-b), no full borders. Call/WhatsApp CTAs prominent.

motion.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Framer Motion for section reveals. Use 'ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]' for premium feel. Do not use bouncy or fast elastic animations. Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all) in CSS.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract paper layers for hero or services background composition.

vintage_ledger.description: Close-up of a vintage handwritten ledger detailing financial records. Use in 'Business Accounting insight' section.

professionals_1.description: Indian business professional in suit. Use for 'Who We Serve' or 'About' section.

professionals_2.description: Two professionals discussing project plans. Use for 'Process' or 'Support' section.

students_1.description: Students learning computers. Use in 'Tally Skills Academy' section.

students_2.description: Woman sitting in front of a computer monitor. Use in 'Tally Skills Academy' curriculum reveal.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Overlay images with a warm tint (Ivory) or deep blue tint (Midnight Ink) using mix-blend-mode or pseudo-elements so they match the color system. Do NOT use placeholder URLs. Always maintain minimum 3:1 contrast ratio over images.

accessibility.instructions: Ensure form inputs have clear accessible labels. High contrast text for all accounting numbers. Do not rely entirely on color to communicate debit/credit (use +/- or up/down arrows). Use data-testid on interactive elements.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do NOT make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Do NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp).
Never use AI assistant emojis. Use Lucide icons.
Provide specific interactive states (hover/focus) with accessible contrast.
All interactive elements must include data-testid.
Use Shadcn components for UI logic but remove Verce/Stripe look to match the editorial brand.
